# Awake

> Awake is a tiny native macOS menu bar app that keeps your Mac awake. Turn it on, turn it off, or set a sunset timer that ends on its own. Start at login, show a countdown in the menu bar, and pick a theme with an accent color. Requires macOS 13 or later.

Awake is an independent app built by Dawid Woźniak and Sature. It keeps the screen awake locally and does not collect or send user data.

## What it does

- On: keep the Mac awake until you turn it off
- Off: return to normal sleep
- Sunset: a timer that ends the session, up to 10 hours
- Start at login
- Optional countdown in the menu bar
- Appearance: Theme 1, 2 and 3, with highlight colors White, Green, Purple and Blue
